reference.title: Pack contents and the manifest
reference.shortdesc: The files in a pack, and the fields of manifest.json.

property.propvalue: DITA-OT 4.4 HTML5 and PDF for this reader's profile.

The request, the source commit and profile, the status, each check's result, one item per requirement with topic, revised date, commit, approver and pull request, every finding with its decision, and a SHA-256 hash for every file.
The same content for a person to read.
One row per requirement and evidence topic.
Hashes of every file, including the manifest, in the format sha256sum -c reads.

section.title: Labels
section.p: A link that the model proposed carries proposed_by: propose_mapping and the person who approved it. A sandbox pack carries sandbox: true and is never sealed.
